date_discrepancy: report.md and this folder name say the ClinVar snapshot was retrieved on 14 September 2026. The papermill block embedded in notebooks/panel_classification.ipynb records the executed run as 2026-09-11T02:38:40Z to 02:41:35Z, and that run is the one every table here was read out of. The machine-attested date is the 11th. Recorded rather than reconciled, because the notebook is committed as executed and report.md is committed unchanged.
derivation: No table here was recomputed. Each was read out of the stored cell output of the executed notebook, so the snapshot is the snapshot report.md describes. Re-running the notebook downloads a current ClinVar release and will not reproduce these counts.
